title: Discharge Liaison Note — The Patient's First Day at Home on a Home Oxygen Therapy Setup
content:
# The Patient's First Day at Home — Home Oxygen Therapy Setup

**Rule.** A Home Oxygen Therapy system delivered for training before the patient came home from a facility starts on the patient's first day at home. The first day at home is found from the referral source on the oxygen record and the patient's oxygen service history:

1. when the order came from a hospital discharge and at least one backup-cylinder delivery is on record later than the initial-setup delivery, the first day at home is the date of the most recent backup-cylinder delivery;
2. otherwise, when the order came from a skilled nursing facility and at least one cylinder refill is on record later than the initial-setup delivery, the first day at home is the date of the most recent cylinder refill;
3. otherwise the first day at home is the initial-setup delivery date itself.

The setup day worked out under this rule is the only setup date and payment-period start recorded for such a system; the date of the initial-setup delivery is carried as the setup date only when the setup day stays on that delivery.

## Input — judgement — output

| Referral source of the order | Delivery on record later than the initial-setup delivery | First day at home |
|---|---|---|
| hospital discharge | at least one backup-cylinder delivery | date of the most recent backup-cylinder delivery |
| hospital discharge | no backup-cylinder delivery later than the initial-setup delivery | the initial-setup delivery date |
| skilled nursing facility | at least one cylinder refill | date of the most recent cylinder refill |
| skilled nursing facility | no cylinder refill later than the initial-setup delivery | the initial-setup delivery date |
| any other source | — | the initial-setup delivery date |

The kinds of delivery are matched to the source: a backup-cylinder delivery counts only for an order from a hospital discharge, and a cylinder refill only for an order from a skilled nursing facility.

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

- **Hospital discharge.** Initial-setup delivery on 3 June for training; backup-cylinder deliveries on 4 June and 5 June. The first day at home is 5 June, the most recent backup-cylinder delivery.
- **Skilled nursing facility.** Initial-setup delivery on 10 September; a cylinder refill on 11 September and no other later refill. The first day at home is 11 September.
- **Skilled nursing facility with only a backup-cylinder delivery later.** Initial-setup delivery on 10 September; a backup-cylinder delivery on 11 September, no later cylinder refill. The first day at home is 10 September, the initial-setup delivery date.
- **Home health referral.** Whatever deliveries follow, the first day at home is the initial-setup delivery date.
